svg.title: Zynara Health · Care Approval IQ — Technical Architecture (v4 · Microsoft Agent Framework)
svg.desc: Prior-authorisation and appeals multi-agent system on the Microsoft Agent Framework: a typed workflow graph of executors, five Foundry reasoning agents bound as MAF AIAgents, a deterministic Gate, a human-in-the-loop RequestPort, Durable Task checkpointing, Cosmos + Blob + Foundry File Search. Document extraction and corpus ETL are assumed upstream (TDD §2.1) and shown as a not-built band.
svg.text: H E A L T H
GPT-5.4 · bound as MAF AIAgents · prose & judgement only, never a decision value

path.d: M1 0 h6 l3 3 v11 h-9 z

g.text: note vs criteria · one at a time

svg.text: no LLM in the control path

g.text: orchestrator · a Microsoft Agent Framework workflow graph

sequences the five checks · owns the Gate — ready to submit / strengthen / human review / abstain · every send pauses at a MAF RequestPort until a human answers · Durable Task checkpoint + replay · writes Cosmos

svg.text: api-proxy relays POST /run + /respond/{runId} — the reviewer's decision resumes the workflow
Submission Adapter (Fn) → payer · portal / X12 278 / FHIR / fax

g.text: policy docs · denial PDFs · precedent narratives
one vector index over the Blob corpus — the agents query it

svg.text: a reviewer approves every outbound action

g.text: human · approves submit and appeal both
Azure Function · read models + reviewer actions

svg.text: applies to every layer · production also adds private networking + an AI-governance layer (per-agent quota & rate limits) — out of scope for this build

g.text: Cosmos RBAC · Foundry · Blob — no stored secrets
payer credential · App Insights · content-share string
each Function identity scoped to what it needs
agent + model spans under one pipeline.run
token usage → £/$ per request · agent · day
submit and appeal both — through the RequestPort
deterministic code owns every decision value
every decision keeps its source docs + full trail
UPSTREAM — NOT BUILTassumed done before Intake — this design does not own it (TDD §2.1)
policy PDF → structured Criteria · clinical-note & denial-letter OCR / text extraction · precedent-record ETL · denial-cohort roll-up for the Recoverable-Value estimate
